title: Mogkompskut (Great Rock)
summary: Mogkompskut names a large boulder in the Hands Creek Road and Three Mile Harbor area of East Hampton. William Wallace Tooker preserved the name from Stephen Pharaoh of the Montaukett Tribe.
address_label: Hands Creek Road near Three Mile Harbor, East Hampton, NY
history_content: The boulder, Montaukett name, and Hands Creek Road landscape remain connected as a single place-name context. Available evidence does not establish a precise field location.
translation_content:
The name is interpreted as "at the great rock." The components are given as mogk-, "great," -ompsk, "rock," and -ut, "at." No alternate spelling is listed in the available references.

Why Place Names Matter

“Indigenous place names are more than just geographical designations. They carry history, culture, and identity, representing a living tradition that connects people to their surroundings.”

— Ekaterina Mikhailova and Karine Nigar Aarskog, The path towards reclaiming Indigenous place names is long and arduous (2025), Opening section, first paragraph
whereintheworld_content: The blue marker is approximate and general. It is placed in the Hands Creek Road area near Three Mile Harbor because the sources identify the road and harbor area but do not provide an exact coordinate for the boulder.
